text: {"lessons":["My account has recovered despite several losing trades, but ten periods are not enough to tell whether I’m beating the market; track results against a suitable benchmark over time.","Repeatedly selling at a loss and later buying back—especially in Stock A and Stock D—suggests I should avoid reactive timing and make trades only when the current evidence changes my view.","Taking some profit in Stock E did not require selling the whole position; size buys and sells deliberately, preserve diversification, and keep cash available for future opportunities."]}
